address.value.zh: 武汉市江岸区黎黄陂路（东南起沿江大道，西北至中山大道，全长约 604 米）
address.value.en: Lihuangpi Road, Jiang'an District, Wuhan (from Yanjiang Avenue in the southeast to Zhongshan Avenue in the northwest, about 604 m long)

intro.value.zh: 604 米长的旧俄租界老街，两侧 17 栋百年欧式建筑，被称为「汉口露天街头博物馆」。现在是武汉咖啡文化最集中的一条街：红砖墙、梧桐影、老洋房改的咖啡馆，适合什么都不干地坐一下午。
intro.value.en: A 604 m old street in the former Russian Concession, lined with 17 century-old European-style buildings and called "Hankou's open-air street museum". Today it's the street with the most cafés in Wuhan: red-brick walls, plane-tree shade, and cafés in old Western-style houses—good for sitting an afternoon away doing nothing.

history.value.zh: 黎黄陂路始建于 1900 年，最初叫黄陂路，划入俄租界后改称夷玛街；1946 年为纪念辛亥首义领袖黎元洪（人称「黎黄陂」）改为现名。街区内保留 17 处欧式历史建筑，涵盖俄式、法式、文艺复兴式等风格。地标巴公房子 1901 年动工、1910 年建成，是当时汉口最大的高等公寓楼，2019 年列入《中国世界文化遗产预备名单》，2021 年列为湖北省文物保护单位，2024 年修缮后作为酒店开业。街区已入选国家级旅游休闲街区。
history.value.en: Lihuangpi Road was built in 1900. It was first called Huangpi Road, then renamed Yima Street after it became part of the Russian Concession; in 1946 it took its present name in memory of Li Yuanhong, a leader of the 1911 Wuchang Uprising, known as "Li Huangpi". The quarter keeps 17 European-style historic buildings in Russian, French, Renaissance and other styles. Its landmark, the Pakhoff House, was begun in 1901 and completed in 1910, and was then the largest high-end apartment building in Hankou; it was put on China's Tentative List for World Cultural Heritage in 2019, listed as a Hubei Provincial Protected Cultural Relic in 2021, and opened as a hotel after restoration in 2024. The quarter has been named a national-level tourism and leisure quarter.

openingHours.value.note.zh: 街区全天开放；店铺多在 10:00 后营业，部分店周一休息；街区内纪念馆（宋庆龄汉口旧居、八七会议会址、中共中央机关旧址）周二至周日 9:00—17:00，周一闭馆。
openingHours.value.note.en: The quarter is open all day; most shops open after 10:00, and some close on Mondays. The memorial halls in the quarter (Soong Ching-ling's former residence in Hankou, the site of the August 7th Meeting, the former site of the CPC Central Committee offices) open Tue–Sun 9:00–17:00, closed Mondays.

ticket.value.note.zh: 优惠：不适用（开放式街区）；汉口二厂游乐乐乐场需单独购票。 免票：街区免费；纪念馆免费但需预约。 咖啡馆、餐厅、手作店为自费项目。
ticket.value.note.en: Concessions: not applicable (open street quarter); the Hankou Erchang playground needs a separate ticket. Free: the quarter is free; the memorial halls are free but need booking. Cafés, restaurants and craft shops are paid.

reservation.value.note.zh: 街区无需预约。宋庆龄汉口旧居、八七会议会址、中共中央机关旧址纪念馆需在官方公众号提前 1—3 天预约。
reservation.value.note.en: No booking needed for the quarter. Soong Ching-ling's former residence in Hankou, the August 7th Meeting site and the former CPC Central Committee offices memorial need booking 1–3 days ahead on their official WeChat accounts.

transport.value.note.zh: 地铁 1/6 号线「大智路」站 B 口出，步行约 8 分钟；或 2/6 号线「江汉路」站步行约 10—15 分钟。公交 559、598、707 至「黎黄陂路」站。街边游客中心可免费寄存行李。
transport.value.note.en: Metro Lines 1/6, Dazhi Road station, exit B, about 8 minutes on foot; or Lines 2/6, Jianghan Road station, about 10–15 minutes on foot. Buses 559, 598, 707 to the Lihuangpi Road stop. The visitor centre on the street stores luggage for free.

bestTime.value.zh: 早上 8:00—10:00 人少光柔，梧桐影打在红砖墙上；下午 16:00—18:00 逆光与树影最好，可顺路走到江滩看日落。
bestTime.value.en: 8:00–10:00 in the morning is quiet with soft light, and plane-tree shadows fall on the red-brick walls; 16:00–18:00 in the afternoon is best for backlight and tree shadows, and you can walk on to the riverside for the sunset.

photoSpots.0.value.description.zh: 鄱阳街与洞庭街交汇处，黎黄陂路口。三角形红砖楼，斜对角拍全景；上午 9—10 点顺光，工作日 10 点前人少
photoSpots.0.value.description.en: Where Poyang Street meets Dongting Street, at the end of Lihuangpi Road. A triangular red-brick building; shoot the whole thing from the diagonal corner. Front-lit 9–10 a.m.; few people before 10 on weekdays.

photoSpots.1.value.description.zh: 黎黄陂路中段巷内。红砖墙、复古门廊与古着店，下午 3—5 点阳光斜照
photoSpots.1.value.description.en: In a lane midway along Lihuangpi Road. Red-brick walls, vintage porches and vintage-clothing shops; slanting sunlight 3–5 p.m.

photoSpots.2.value.description.zh: 鄱阳街与天津路一带。拜占庭式穹顶，仰拍塔身与天空
photoSpots.2.value.description.en: Around Poyang Street and Tianjin Road. A Byzantine-style dome; shoot upward at the tower against the sky.

photoSpots.3.value.title.en: Terrace of the Old Times Café

photoSpots.3.value.description.zh: 主街中段。露台正对欧式老街，二楼俯拍街景与行人
photoSpots.3.value.description.en: Midway along the main street. The terrace faces the old European street; from the first floor, shoot down on the street and passers-by.

food.0.value.note.zh: 本地过早老字号，热干面、豆皮、糊米酒
food.0.value.note.en: A long-established local breakfast shop: hot dry noodles, doupi, hu mijiu (rice wine soup).

food.1.value.note.zh: 俄领事馆旧址，武汉最早一批猫咖
food.1.value.note.en: In the former Russian Consulate; one of Wuhan's earliest cat cafés.

food.2.value.note.zh: 广式糖水，老街里的小店
food.2.value.note.en: Cantonese sweet soups; a small shop on the old street.

food.3.value.note.zh: 过早与夜宵都集中，步行约 5 分钟
food.3.value.note.en: Breakfast and late-night food in one place; about 5 minutes on foot.
